market.what: ion-exchange membranes + ionomers in PEM and AEM water electrolyzers, world
market.method: est.: ~5 GW shipped (58 GW/yr capacity at ~9% use); PEM ~1.4 GW x ~$25/kW membrane+ionomer + AEM ~0.1 GW x ~$30/kW. Fact.MR $0.4B covers all AEM ionomer uses

value.logic: est. 2032 AEM ~1.5 GW/yr (~15% of ~9-10 GW/yr); ionomer that lasts lets AEM replace PEM (no PGM/Ti, stack ~$200/kW now, ~$97/kW at scale) and halves stack swaps: ~$150/kW x 1.5 GW
value.revenue_logic: 1.5 GW x ~$30/kW membrane+ionomer = $45M pool x ~25-30% share via license to a membrane maker
value.margin_logic: ionomer sells at $1,000s/kg in tiny volumes; royalty route ~90

trend.drivers: electrolyzer deployment ~5 GW (2025) to ~9 GW/yr avg; AEM moving from demo to commercial; PFAS pressure on PFSA membranes
trend.deadline: EU RED III: 42% RFNBO share of industrial H2 by 2030; ECHA PFAS restriction opinion 2026

competition.paper_query: anion exchange ionomer alkaline stability electrolyzer
competition.notes: Ionomr ~$39M total ($20M A-4, Dec 2023, Shell/Chevron/Asahi Kasei); Versogen $14.5M Series A (Chemours); Evonik DURAION plant online end-2025, enough for 2.5 GW/yr

lab.synth: model cation 1-2 step custom (3 variants), then graft best onto a polymer backbone (polymer, 10-16 wk)
lab.test: model cation + membrane in 1-3 M KOH at 80C for 1,000 h, NMR + IEC/conductivity loss; then short MEA cell test; university membrane lab
lab.logic: model synth 5 wk + KOH/NMR 6 wk, polymer 10 wk overlapping; synth $15k + polymer $25k + testing ~$10k

sale.gates: OEM single-cell 2,000-5,000 h at <4 mV/kh; stack test; field pilot; membrane maker scale-up
